title: Overlay lobby status response (PRF-02 slice 6, catalogue module #16)
description: The overlay-facing projection of a channel's current lobby session, scoped by the overlay session token. It is AGGREGATE STATUS ONLY: seats, confirmed seats and a queue count. There is no room code, no password, no seat token, no player identifier, no in-game name, no Discord name, no viewer id, no anonymous identity and no session id on this path -- not withheld, but absent from the read's declared result type and from the schema behind it. Opted-in initials and avatars are deliberately out of scope: they require an opt-in mechanism that does not exist. A null lobbyStatus is what an unrecognised, expired, revoked or foreign overlay token returns, and also what a channel with no open lobby and a channel without the Creator+/Events Pack entitlement return -- all four mean paint nothing.

seatCount.description: Total seats in the lobby. The minimum is arithmetic, not policy -- a lobby with no seats cannot render a seat status. There is no product maximum: the upper bound here is PostgreSQL integer's own range, so an out-of-range value is a contract failure rather than a storage failure.

confirmedSeatCount.description: Seats confirmed so far -- the left half of '8/16 seats confirmed'. Never greater than seatCount; the database enforces that with its own check constraint.

queueCount.description: How many people are waiting. A count, never a list: there is no per-viewer row anywhere behind this figure, so nothing here can correlate one visit to another.
